title: DistilBook: Turn Any PDF Into a Hand-Drawn Explainer
summary: A 40 s light, airy product walkthrough for DistilBook. Opens with a handwritten line ('A good teacher doesn't read the page. They draw it.'), reveals the logo, then walks a 3-step flow with a green/blue/pink step progress bar at the top: Add your material → Read the script, fix any line → Watch every idea get drawn. Each step pairs a bold left-aligned headline with a floating, rebuilt UI card on the right. Closes with proof beats (Not a week. About 6 minutes.), a wall of example outputs, format/language/branding features, and a logo + CTA pill.
fit_reason: Calm, step-by-step 'how it works' with headline-left/UI-right layout and a step progress bar: exactly how to teach an onboarding/portal feature.

palette.mood: light airy off-white, soft shadows, one colour per step (green / blue / pink) with blue as the brand highlight

typography.display: bold neo-grotesk (Inter Bold / SF Pro Display) for headlines; handwritten marker font (e.g. Gaegu / Patrick Hand) for the opener
typography.size_behaviour: medium two-line headline left-aligned with small grey subline; big centred single lines for proof beats
typography.notes: Tiny tracked uppercase eyebrow in step colour ('STEP 1'). Headlines end with full stops. Key value in brand blue ('About 6 minutes', '9:16', 'full motion'). Strikethrough in pink on 'week'.

text_animation: handwritten text writes on letter-by-letter, second line in blue with underline drawn
headline lines rise from a mask with slight blur, staggered per line
karaoke-style word highlight in the narration caption (current word in pink/magenta)
captions: karaoke highlight inside the product demo only: two-line centred caption under the drawing, inactive words light grey, spoken word pink #cd245e, no box
motion: step progress bars fill left to right and tick
UI card slides/fades in from right with soft shadow
file chip flies into the drop zone and a green check appears
camera pull-back reveals a wall of example videos then pushes into one
transitions: UI morph between steps (card stays, content swaps)

drop zone, file chip, approve button (blue → green 'Approved')
ui_treatment: Rebuilt simplified product UI as a single floating card on the right half, headline on the left; later full-width output previews.

sound.voiceover: no main VO; a sample narration plays inside the 'Watch' step demo (AI voice reading the slide)
